Preserved byte-for-byte in the immutable source snapshot but intentionally not activated at the Monorepo root. This manual diagnostic creates a 5-GB temporary disk file and allocates about 4 GB RAM; it is not called by the product API or another workflow. The root runner-allocation diagnostic provides a low-impact allocation/shell smoke check. Keep the heavy benchmark archived unless a separately reviewed operator need justifies an explicitly gated manual run.

A dedicated root CI port now validates both the exact 006d NISAR parser/GOFF source pin and the promoted Find Displacements tools/dashboard. It compiles the engine, checks generated JavaScript syntax, parses root AOI workflow YAML and runs the historical source plus promoted engine suites. The old Backend Run-32 artifact download from another repository is intentionally not reused; the Monorepo has a separate same-repository Dashboard Real Artifact Smoke workflow. Verify current-head CI and compare any remaining fixture differences before closure.

Renamed to an isolated Find Displacements catalogue-only diagnostic. Verify WKT/date input contract, immutable science-source selection, ASF diagnostics and the new fail-closed gate; do not enable downloads or Drive writes.
Root reusable AOI product worker exists; compare required inputs, source pin, cleanup, artifact names and failure status semantics.
Root API-facing caller exists separately from the workflow_call engine; compare dispatch schema, callbacks, retries, artifact identity and terminal status.
Root manual AOI dispatcher exists; it is not interchangeable with the API-facing dashboard workflow.
Root extended-science workflow exists; verify its historical science pin, input/output contract and manual gate.

A separate Monorepo root workflow now retains the source workflow's two fixed P05023 products (one GUNW, one GOFF) as sequential matrix entries. It is manual-only and requires both MONOREPO_SARGUARDIAN_LIVE_VALIDATION_ENABLED=true and confirm_live_retention=true. It materializes the exact ab547 science commit from Monorepo Git history with git worktree, uses promoted Find Displacements retention tools, uploads engine-ready archive/provenance to Drive with receipt verification, and has no automatic raw-file deletion. Validate its structural contract and CI before considering the live gate.
Root streaming reusable worker exists and remains distinct from the AOI product worker; compare inputs, outputs, retries and cleanup.
Renamed/scoped as Find Displacements retained-artifact reassembly. Verify run-ID inputs, historical artifact names, six artifact classes, pinned science revision and Drive receipt parity.

The Monorepo now runs the full immutable Backend-main source snapshot test suite (tools/ and tests/) in its own secret-free CI workflow. The workflow also compiles the entire source tree and parses the source retention workflow YAML. The source workflow's pinned-science regression job is covered separately by the root Snapshot Regression NISAR science job against the imported 9fcb main tree.
Root pilot is engine-scoped and fail-closed. Verify all source inputs, one-granule constraint, science pin, no-delete invariant and Drive receipt handling.

Preserved byte-for-byte in the legacy-fork and Backend workflow snapshots but intentionally not activated at the Monorepo root. Root streaming batch exists; verify manifest, 15-at-a-time batching where applicable, failed-only retries, preassembly checks and final failure propagation.
